limitations: GX mode2 uses instruction calibration; mode3 uses epoch elapsed time and is not CPU instruction attribution. Neither establishes a hardware timing bound.

Mode2 has 40 unmatched launches across two requests on both sides (99.9478% launch coverage) and identical compute inventories. Mode3 baseline has 10 unmatched malformed tensorTransformGeneric launches, candidate has 40 other unmatched cuDNN launches; plan selection differed despite equal transfer totals and normalization shapes. Mode3 thus has a kernel-plan confound. GPU calibration used vram_limit=2; full-offload uses zero.

A100 verification uses ABBA process order, three warmed requests per process and six per variant on one fixed input. All twelve output hashes match. The modest gain is not a production-distribution claim.

Loader timings are host times under GX mode0, using fresh processes and already cached checkpoint files. They exclude imports and generation and are not mode2/3 predictions. Loaded-state hash covers all1261tensors; this is separate from native generation output checks.

Loader mmap assumes immutable checkpoint files while mapped. Legacy Torch checkpoint archives fall back to ordinary loading. The norm optimization falls back for buffers, hooks, custom conversions, and mutable state.

async_uploads.baseline: Previously hardened normalization copying; checkpoint loader change also present on both sides. This is an incremental comparison, not original upstream versus all changes.
async_uploads.change: Opt-in nonblocking CPU-to-CUDA weight uploads during inference. CPU weights remain pipeline-owned and immutable; consumption remains stream-ordered. CPU/D2H/autograd paths retain original behavior.
async_uploads.flag: DIFFSYNTH_ASYNC_WEIGHT_UPLOADS=0 versus 1, sampled at module import

before.interpretation: Each counter is interval-union occupancy per time bin, across a rank's streams within one category. Categories overlap and must not be summed as GPU utilization. No individual kernels or arrows. Counters are rounded to 0.01 percentage points; sub-bin gaps are averaged. Full dependency records remain in the capture archives.

limitations: Both GX timing pairs selected different cuDNN plans; launch misses receive no predicted service. Exact attribution of the predicted change is limited.
Mode-2 instruction CPU work increases slightly; this change reduces host waiting and improves overlap, rather than reducing transferred bytes or arithmetic.

The first native candidate group contains a 15.393-second measured request. It is retained in every aggregate for that experiment. A separate fixed-length repeat was scheduled to investigate variability, not to replace the original samples.
Same single prompt, seed and shape; no claim for concurrent weight mutation, arbitrary streams or training.
Inherited calibration limitations: GPU profile used adaptive 2-GiB residency; timing runs force full offload, and CPU calibration contains unresolved samples.
